item.tib: tshe sgrub 'od dkar dpag med kyi sngon 'gro gta' chen gyi rim pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i phya g.yang sgrub pa'i gta' chen gyi shog chung 'di yang / las kyi 'phro can 'ga' yis bskul phyir/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng*/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ming g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ gong ma'i gdan sa shar grol smin gling du yi ger btab pa 'dis kyang bon bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
